If you have a question about the property, simply use the enquiry button (e.g. "Request details" or "Email agent") and your message will be sent directly to the landlord. ** The Apartment: This brand new spacious one-bedroom apartment at Canal Club, Wickside offers well-designed modern living in a vibrant canal side setting. The property features a large open-plan living and dining area and lots of storage. Apartments are complimented by full-height windows that maximise natural light throughout. A private balcony extends the living space outdoors, providing a peaceful spot to enjoy the surrounding waterside environment. The apartment includes a well-proportioned bedroom, a sleek, fully fitted kitchen with integrated Smeg appliances and a contemporary bathroom finished to a high specification. A £500 incentive whilst the finishing touches are being completed is available for the first 6 months renting at your new home. Canal Club, Wickside: Brand-new and ready to create a community like no other, Canal Club, Wickside comprises 176 rental apartments in trendy Hackney Wick. The surrounding area is one of East London's most distinctive and fast-evolving neighbourhoods. Hackney Wick is known for its creative and cultural scene, with independent cafés, breweries, restaurants, galleries and studios lining the canals and former warehouses.
